rows.name:
The Divine Beast went whoosh and
moved, mo! That surprised me, mo!!

rows.label: tlk42100181_04_msg0002
rows.name:
But Magomago isn't scared, mo!
I'm with Grandpa, so I'm fine, mo!

rows.label: tlk42100181_04_msg0003
rows.name:
Grandpa said it's the Nopon spirit to
bring in goods at times like this, mo!
